verifier_contract.collection_integrity: JUnit contains exactly 23 unique, passing, non-skipped cases for full reward.
behaviors: mixed full-attention and GDN workers initialize through the existing connector interface
full-attention, MLA, sliding-window MLA, and both GDN conv and temporal-state payloads reach their matching destination blocks
null state placeholders are ignored and unrequested bytes across complete backing allocations remain unchanged
padded attention views and production-shaped shared-page GDN views stay within valid registered memory
full-attention and GDN groups can share one backing allocation and base address while retaining distinct transfer regions and destination blocks
full-attention, MLA, and sliding-window MLA logical-to-physical block ratios greater than one do not overlap or corrupt neighboring blocks
failed transfers and producer-consumer layout or group-count mismatches cannot report completion with incorrect destination state

for supported prompts of at least two elements, cache-only GDN remote prefill and decode preserve the exact final-element recomputation boundary for token IDs and prompt embeddings on producer and consumer sides
consumer prompt embeddings wait for N-1 remote elements, resume with one local element after transfer completion, and preserve pure-attention accounting
the exact two-element supported boundary works for token IDs and prompt embeddings on producer and consumer schedulers
non-power-of-two logical-to-physical ratios preserve requested payloads through the composed transfer E2E
partial-prefix transfers select each producer group's requested suffix while preserving null placeholders and untouched destination data
cold and fully cached warm requests complete and a subsequent request confirms the prefill scheduler remains healthy
pure full-attention Mooncake transfer and NIXL GDN remote-prefill token accounting remain compatible

e2e_boundary.path: hybrid KV configuration and partial-prefix P/D request metadata -> real Mooncake worker construction and deduplicated backing registration -> real metadata encoding/decoding, group-aware ratio-three and cross-group shared-backing transfer planning, and producer send lifecycle -> pointer-based copy into consumer CPU tensors and completion status
e2e_boundary.scheduler_composition: Cold token-ID, cold prompt-embedding, warm-prefix, and consumer prompt-embedding cases enter through the real Scheduler.add_request, Scheduler.schedule, and Scheduler.update_from_output lifecycle. The consumer case waits for remote state, receives a real KVConnectorOutput completion, resumes with one local prompt element, and finishes. Producer token-ID and prompt-embedding cases also compare the retained public request input with the exact original prefix.
e2e_boundary.substitution: Deterministic CPU tensors replace model forward passes. Attention tensors preserve their declared physical layout, while GDN conv and temporal tensors are production-shaped as_strided views over page-strided backing allocations. A dedicated HMA fixture gives full-attention and GDN the same storage and base address. An in-memory engine replaces native Mooncake RDMA and validates registered ranges before performing the exact pointer-based copies requested by production connector code. A loopback socket replaces ZMQ transport while retaining production message encoding and response handling.
e2e_boundary.preserved_semantics: Cache group cardinality and order, cross-group shared base addresses, non-overlapping registration coverage with distinct logical regions, power-of-two and non-power-of-two logical-to-physical block identities, per-group partial-prefix suffix selection, GDN shared-page shapes, offsets and strides, both recurrent-state payloads, complete backing bytes, null placeholders, registration ranges, prompt element order, request completion, and cold/warm lifecycle state are preserved without requiring one registration partitioning strategy.
e2e_boundary.limitations: The verifier does not execute GPU kernels, model weights, native Mooncake RDMA/NVLink, multi-node transport, or full-model accuracy evaluation. It does not claim coverage for Mamba variants other than GDN.

independent_challenge.case: An unpublished 80-byte padded allocation shared by full-attention and production-shaped GDN views, with non-contiguous per-group partial-prefix source and destination blocks.
